# Unified timeline: video, voice and subtitles all share this one file.
# Arithmetic the checker enforces:
#   len(clip_range)  == len(source_range)
#   len(final_range) == len(clip_range) / speed + freeze
#   clip_range and final_range must not overlap within one asset_id
# Semantic audit (check_timeline_audit.py audit) additionally enforces:
#   anchor_asset / anchor_event / anchor_source are cross-checked against THIS row's real shot
#   span: a line may not be anchored to another event, and its referenced source interval must
#   lie inside the shot (a cross-turn shot, event_id `a+b`, must have the line cover the span)
#   any cross-phase line must declare claim_mode=retrospective, and one event may not
#     claim a phase the picture has not reached yet
#   freeze>0 needs hold_mark with the held source timecode; a reward hold also needs
#   visible_window, and its anchor must fall INSIDE that window
#   narration must fit its own picture window; long silences need a per-gap ledger row
#   the three *_sha256 columns bind THIS timeline to the actual subtitle/audio/cut by CONTENT
#     (same segment count but re-worded, re-timed or replaced output still fails)
#   the 64-zero digests below are placeholders for readability: a real run must carry the real
